title: Browse every folder
line: Your phone opens in a TwoPort window on your Mac: Camera, Downloads, WhatsApp, every folder.
voice: Your whole phone opens in a window on your Mac. Camera, Downloads, WhatsApp, every folder.

title: Search the whole phone
line: Type a name, or ask for every video on the phone, newest first.
voice: Looking for something? Type a name, or ask for every video on the phone, newest first.

title: Watch videos without downloading
line: Double-click a video and it plays straight from the phone. Save a copy only if you want one.
voice: Double-click a video, and it plays straight from the phone. Save a copy only if you want one.

title: Flip through photos
line: A gallery view you page through with the arrow keys.
voice: Flip through your photos in a gallery, with the arrow keys.

title: Rename, delete, new folder
line: Tidy up the phone from your Mac's keyboard.
voice: Rename, delete, or make a new folder, right from your Mac's keyboard.

title: Several phones at once
line: Yours, a work phone, the family's. Each one shows up by name.
voice: More than one phone? Yours, a work phone, the family's. Each one shows up by name.

title: Share from phone to Mac
line: In any app, tap Share, then TwoPort. It lands in your Mac's Downloads a second later.
voice: On your phone, tap Share, then TwoPort. A moment later, it's in your Mac's Downloads.

title: Send from Mac to phone
line: Right-click files in Finder, or drop them on TwoPort in the menu bar.
voice: Going the other way? Right-click files in Finder, or drop them on TwoPort in the menu bar.

title: Drag from phone to Mac
line: Drag photos and files out of the TwoPort window into any folder on your Mac.
voice: Drag photos and files out of the TwoPort window, into any folder on your Mac.

title: Copy on phone, paste in Finder
line: Press ⌘C in the TwoPort window and ⌘V in any Finder folder. Nothing downloads until you paste.
voice: Copy on your phone, and paste in Finder. Nothing downloads until you paste.

title: Back up only what's new
line: Photos, videos, documents, music, apps, any file: you pick the kinds and folders. One click brings over what's new.
voice: Back up in one click. Pick the kinds of files and the folders you want, and only what's new comes over.

title: Original dates kept
line: Photos and files keep the day they were made, not the day they were copied.
voice: Your photos keep the day they were taken, not the day they were copied.

title: Sorted by month
line: Photos and videos in one folder per month; other files keep the phone's folders.
voice: Photos and videos land in one folder per month. Everything else keeps the phone's folders.

title: Mac to phone, automatic
line: Turn it on once on your Mac, then copy as usual. It's already on your phone's clipboard.
voice: Turn it on once, then copy on your Mac as usual. It's already on your phone's clipboard.

title: Phone to Mac, automatic
line: Turn it on once in the phone app, then copy as usual and press ⌘V on your Mac.
voice: It works the other way too. Copy on your phone, then press Command V on your Mac.

title: Send clipboard button
line: A button in your phone's quick settings sends whatever you just copied.
voice: Or tap Send clipboard, right in your phone's quick settings.

title: Photos and files too
line: Copy a screenshot on your Mac and paste it into a chat on your phone, and back.
voice: Photos and files copy too. Grab a screenshot on your Mac, and paste it straight into a chat.

title: Clipboard history
line: Everything you copied on either side, a click away on your Mac.
voice: Everything you copied, on either side, is a click away on your Mac.

title: Passwords never cross
line: Anything your phone or Mac marks as sensitive, like a password, stays where it is.
voice: And passwords never cross. Anything marked as sensitive stays right where it is.

title: Pair once
line: Scan a code once. After that, TwoPort finds your phone by itself.
voice: Setting up takes one scan. After that, TwoPort finds your phone by itself.

title: Reconnects by itself
line: Whenever your phone and Mac are on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing to tap.
voice: Whenever your phone and Mac are on the same Wi-Fi, they connect again. Nothing to tap.

title: Keeps going when screens lock
line: Lock your phone or your Mac. A transfer carries on.
voice: Lock your phone, or your Mac. A transfer carries on.

title: USB cable, much faster
line: Plug in and click Use USB once. Unplug any time and it carries on over Wi-Fi.
voice: In a hurry? Plug in a USB cable, and big copies go much faster. Unplug any time, and it carries on over Wi-Fi.

title: Quick Send, no app needed
line: A friend scans a code with their phone's camera and sends you photos from the web browser.
voice: Friends don't need the app. They scan a code with their camera, and send you photos from the browser.

title: Picks up after a break
line: If the Wi-Fi drops mid-way, a big batch carries on from where it stopped.
voice: And if the Wi-Fi drops halfway, a big batch picks up right where it stopped.
